first.rationale: I currently intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates this can improve time-to-value and early adoption without relying on discounts. I want to verify that result and the promotional-pricing tradeoffs before committing, since competitor pricing may warrant a targeted response but could reduce qualified-revenue quality or create downstream margin risk. The experiment should be guarded with qualification, retention, and revenue-quality checks.
